reviews.author: Jim Harrison
reviews.text: I have had oil and tire changes done on multiple vehicles and was pleased with all services until this week. Last Thursday I called to get estimate for an oil change, coolant flush and transmission service to include filter change. I was told they had the filter in stock. I asked if the service could be done that day and was told that due to the holiday rush I would need to wait till the following Tuesday. The estimate I was quoted was $465.00 total. I had another trip planned to the beach before Tuesday so I had the oil changed elsewhere. When I brought the car in Wednesday of this week they did not have an oil filter in stock or available until Thursday. Since the vehicle was there Wednesday they did the coolant change and replaced transmission fluid for a total price of $333.82. I brought the car back on Thursday for the filter change. They then charged for the filter and another complete change of fluid For another charge of $285.65. Those services totaled $619.47 not including the oil change I had done elsewhere. They drained and replaced fluid twice in two days. That totaled $150 dollars over the total estimate without doing an oil change which I paid $119.00 elsewhere. I will not only never return here but will gladly share my poor experience with all my friends and associates!!

reviews.author: Kayla Irving
reviews.text: Came with a tire lock on both of my tires and I don’t have a key for them . Mr.Roger was able to unlock them without hesitation, and put on two new tires for me . Highly recommend . great communication and very understanding and he’s very fair with pricing .

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text: Rogers Tire n Auto is the only place I truly trust to bring my vehicles in to get serviced. They take good care of the vehicles there and don’t sell you in more than you need. They are respectable folks who truly do right by the customer. Thank you Tripp and the rest for always taking care of us and for the honest and hard work you put into our vehicles!

reviews.author: Sue Crance
reviews.text: I had a tire that had a screw in it and Steven patched it for me. I didn’t have an appointment and I was in a hurry, He did a great job! Support this family business they rock!

reviews.author: Kevin Lail
reviews.text: I've taken my car several times to this place, always a good experience. Down to earth local folks. I like supporting local businesses, but only if they do well. Like I said, reasonable prices and they do a good job. Thanks you all!

reviews.author: Glenn Votipka
reviews.text: Went in for tire losing air & going flat. Even though there was other work going on they took me in immediately. They found the leak and plugged it in no time and then even took the time to check out the other tires. When it came time to pay when they found out I was a disabled combat veteran they gave me a HUGE discount. Courteous & friendly people that seemed willing to do whatever it takes. Thanks, Rogers Tire N Auto for a job well done.

reviews.author: Keith Eaton
reviews.text: They did an awesome job. Especially on the 35" tires that's sitting on my truck. Great people down-to-earth tell you like it is. I will continue driving 35 to 45 minutes out of the way for their services

reviews.author: Lonnie P
reviews.text: I went to several mechanics. Found Roger's Tire and Auto. These guys fixed my ride in less than 24 hours for half the price the other mechanics were trying to charge. I appericate the honesty. We will be back. I recommend Roger's tire and Auto.

reviews.author: Linda Collins
reviews.text: Hey everyone....just wanted to say a few things about this business, they were polite everytime we spoke with them but....I am posting this for my neighbor who recently had his car in for repair...they came got the car with a wrecker as it would not go when you pressed the gas...told my neighbor they would let him know what was wrong and price before doing anything , they did not, they put a few parts on and said it was fixed . Picked my neighbor up to take back to the shop to settle the bill and on the way it did the same thing...charged my neighbor $500. then took it back to be fixed again another $383. The car run for 3 days and was worse than before. We had to have the car towed back home from another towing company...$50. I should have said my neighbor is on a fixed income and told them so....called them and told them it was worse than when they fixed it and he couldn't afford to pay anymore. They said let us get it back and we will make it right , I said well he don't have anymore money to pay yall. We understand they said...calls us later to say its the ECM computer and that cost would be $483 to fix , but since he had paid so much already they would knock off $200 on the price and only charge him for the computer $283. Well we told them to wait and let us talk, meanwhile I called a few auto parts places to get a price on a computer yeah you guessed it $103 for the computer wow what a rip off when you know the guy is on a fixed income already spent close to $900 and you want to charge him $283 for a part that cost $103.? So we told them to just bring the car home, long review short don't take your car there unless you have money to just throw away. A friend got the computer $103 and put it in in less than 20 minutes really......They are a total rip off artist....and there is a special place for people like that who treat the elderly in such a manner. If there was a no star I would use it....!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Ashley Bebout
reviews.text: Short and rude. Wouldn't even let me finish asking what all i needed to ask without telling me i have to bring my vehicle up to be checked out. We know what needs to be done, but don't have the tools, means, or time to do it. Would have been nice to have been heard out instead of brushed off. We won't be using this shop and that was just based off a phone call.

reviews.author: Tim Huemmer
reviews.text: Very quick service. They diagnosed the issue quickly and started working on it right away. They did not provide an estimate until I asked for one. I would make sure to do this as they didn't seem like they were going to provide that until I asked

reviews.author: Chris Porter
reviews.text: Classic case of "I should have listened to the Google reviews"... I read them, hoped that the other people just had bad luck because the place was close enough to my house that I wouldn't have to get the car towed. I basically just got $300 stolen from me, the check engine light came on the very next day and they "cant do anything about it"... Seriously, if you dont listen to me, listen to everyone else, DONT GO HERE!

reviews.author: Bailey Livingston
reviews.text: They had great customer service! They were super kind and fix my car within 30 minutes! Definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: Philip Hale
reviews.text: Don’t take your car to this place. I can’t even get tires off my car because they torqued the lug nuts on so tight. Tells you the quality of work.

reviews.author: Jennifer Davis
reviews.text: They screwed us. They put in a new battery we didn't need and then when the car broke down a SECOND TIME they "all of a sudden" had to fix the alternator which was the problem in the first place. I hate this place and will NEVER go back there again. Roger, you suck!

reviews.author: Amanda Shelton
reviews.text: The mechanic there came out to my house after doing some brake repairs bc i was having a issue...i didnt even get his name but want to thank him for coming out on his day off to help me. Great guy!!! Whatever your name is Thanks for solving my problem!!!

reviews.author: Tonya Stewart
reviews.text: This guy is a mechanic, people take their cars to a mechanic because they can't fix them themselves. He fixed front brakes on a car, He DID tell the customer other things customer needed, BUT DID NOT tell customer his car had no brakes when he left his lot. Told customer it needs to be fixed but could last few days, could use er brake if needed, but DID NOT say you have no brakes, Then when family called to inform him of this, the mechanic was VERY DISRESPECTFUL, RUDE, THREATENING AND UNPROFESSIONAL. HE SHOULD BE EMBARRASSED TO CALL HIMSELF A MECHANIC! TOO MANY OTHER SHOPS TO DEAL WITH THIS PATHETIC EXCUSE OF AN AUTO SHOP! e risks

reviews.author: marwan salaita
reviews.text: One of the best workshops around here, I used them for few times and I had nothing but good service and good price.

reviews.author: Michael Conway
reviews.text: Rogers tire is an excellent auto establishment and mechanics are professionals and friendly and also quick. Thumbs up. And reasonable prices as well.

reviews.author: Nadir Rogers
reviews.text: Quick, great, friendly service. Reasonable & nearly u beatable prices. Gets the job you want done right THE FIRST TIME

reviews.author: Jay Avants
reviews.text: Very pleased with the service that we got from Rogers.the staff is always friendly and helpful and I am pleased to have such talented gentlemen service my vehicle.

reviews.author: Charles Brentnell
reviews.text: These people are cheats and Liars They are true scumbags they will rob you. Don't go there for any reason! PLEASE NOTE... All the positive reviews on this site, are from their friends and relatives.

reviews.author: Heather Maitland
reviews.text: This is one of the few mechanics that I trust in the upstate. I've gone to Rogers for years they always take good care of me and are very honest

reviews.author: Donna Henry
reviews.text: This place doubles the price of the partsthat the put on, the price for lLabour isn't to bad but the will rip you off. The owner is very RUDE.

reviews.author: willie dempsey
reviews.text: Great little garage shop and the people are very helpful they treat the vehicles probably better than their own.

reviews.author: Julie Sanfilippo
reviews.text: I am sure glad I found this place. I drive by all the time. I went in for a quick fix for some loose plastic under my car it was fixed in a few minutes. Lisa was so kind! I asked her for an estimate for some other things my car needed she quoted me an unbelievable great price! Took my car in yesterday and it was done to perfection in one day. I am so happy I found a place where I can take my car that is local. I will recommend them to my family and friends and anyone that needs a great mechanic!! Thanks to Lisa and her great staff
